items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, I didn't know. I didn't know.

ctx.x: I'll try to look it up. When I listen to this, I'll remember to do it. But it covers the early days of sports. I guess I knew a couple of people that plugged songs. It seemed to me Sammy Rosenbaum did. Sam Rosenbaum. He worked for Triangle. Maybe he managed it. It was Treasurer or something. That's a local firm.
No, I didn't know. I didn't know.
